steps.en: Install the Ronny stack in your existing host
steps.zh: 在现有宿主安装 Ronny 包

steps.en: Makes independent-review available as a skill
Provide diff, requirements and actual test output to a fresh reviewer
steps.zh: 向新审查上下文交付改动、需求和测试实录

steps.en: Guides the reviewer to return located findings with reasons and severity
steps.zh: 指导审查者返回有位置、理由和严重度的发现

steps.en: Confirm findings in the real code before accepting fixes
steps.zh: 在真实代码中确认发现，再接受修复

value.en: A review handoff based on evidence rather than the author's inherited explanation
value.zh: 用证据交接审查，而非继承作者解释
